h: Oyo lawmaker says National Assembly is 'not a battlefield' as he rejects rubber-stamp claims
p: A House of Representatives member from Oyo State has reportedly rejected accusations that the National Assembly simply approves whatever the Tinubu government sends. He argued that lawmakers and the executive are meant to work together.
more: Critics say the legislature has approved borrowing requests too quickly.
The Senate is currently considering a $20.5bn external borrowing request.
